overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance metrics highlights a clear audience preference for space and cosmic anomaly 'What If' scenarios and extreme planetary facts published within the recent 7-day window. Videos structured around hypothetical planetary immersion (e.g., liquid diamond planets, burning ice planets) and extreme cosmic phenomena (e.g., Venus day length, dark planets) dramatically outperform standard biological facts or older science trivia in both views-per-day and engagement ratios (likes-per-view).

winning_patterns.pattern: Hypothetical Planetary Immersion ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) generated over 900-1,000 views rapidly with high like ratios (e.g., 38 likes on IYuce8vaU3Y).
winning_patterns.action: Produce more high-stakes, sensory-driven 'What If' planetary immersion scenarios focusing on extreme physics and surreal environments.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U) drove over 980-1,027 views with strong engagement within days of publishing.
winning_patterns.action: Focus future scripts on counter-intuitive astronomical measurements and extreme exoplanet behaviors rather than general space facts.

weak_patterns.evidence: Older or repeat-themed psychological tricks and standard animal facts (e.g., 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' variants and repetitive octopus facts) yielded flat view counts (<50 views per day after the initial push).
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standard psychological tricks and repetitive animal trivia unless paired with a high-concept cinematic survival or mystery micro-story.

weak_patterns.evidence: Longer-tail historical mysteries (e.g., 'The 2,000-Year-Old Mystery Science Can't Solve') had minimal likes-per-view and stagnant growth compared to fast-paced space shorts.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid vague historical mystery hooks; pivot historical storytelling into concrete, high-tension micro-drama or country/geography mysteries.
